collection.description: A researcher plans to climb the Great Falls: go with the plan, or follow the scientists' advice.

intro.text: (subject) is known for their crazy, spontaneous, yet sometimes genius ideas. (subject.he/she) is an avid researcher and has been studying the tribe's history for a long time. (subject.he/she) believes that two of the tribe's founders fell down the Great Falls, but nothing definitive is known about their origins. (subject) proposes trying to retrace their steps by climbing the waterfall and offers to devise a plan. The others are skeptical about (subject.his/her) claims and warn (subject.him/her) not to take matters into (subject.his/her) own hands without further proof. (subject) knows that the plan could be dangerous, but what if (subject.he/she) is right? Should (subject.he/she) go through with (subject.his/her) plan, or follow the other researchers' advice?

plan.text: (Subject) revises (subject.his/her) plan until (subject.he/she) believes it is practically foolproof. At dawn the next morning, (subject.he/she) sneaks out of the hut before anyone else has woken up and makes their way toward the waterfall. Setting up (subject.his/her) climbing gear, (subject.he/she) makes the perilous ascent up the falls.

fall.text: For several hours, (subject.he/she) carefully scales the jagged rocks until (subject.he/she) can almost see over the edge of the falls. Just a little further... Oops! (subject)'s hand loses its grip and (subject.he/she) falls many dozens of meters to the hard, unforgiving ground. When the villagers wake up, they discover (subject)'s body and weep bitterly for their fallen colleague. (subject.He/She) will be remembered as a passionate dreamer that dared to do the impossible.

summit.text: For several hours, (subject.he/she) carefully scales the jagged rocks until (subject.he/she) can almost see over the edge of the falls. Just a little further... With one last stretch, (subject) climbs onto the final rock and stands in victory. From this height, (subject.he/she) can see over the entire village and jungle canopy. (subject.He/She) thinks (subject.he/she) can even see other settlements from up here! Behind (subject.him/her), (subject.he/she) hears the rushing of the falls echoing through a large cave mouth leading to somewhere unknown. Checking (subject.his/her) notes and doing some quick calculations, (subject.he/she) is almost certain the cave tunnel must lead somewhere close to the Southern Shore of Isola. (Subject) fervently writes down (subject.his/her) deductions and makes a detailed sketch of the area before making the careful descent back home. That day, (subject.he/she) presents (subject.his/her) findings to the others, who work together to perfect (subject.his/her) plan. Over several months they send an expedition team to the perilous peak, and confirm that (subject) was right about everything. They name (subject) a Distinguished Scientist, and recognize (subject.his/her) achievements in a grand ceremony. (subject) is certainly setting a name for (subject.himself/herself) throughout the entire scientific community! Your village gains (award) tech points.

advice.text: (subject) admits that (subject.his/her) plan still needs some refining. (subject.He/She) goes back to the drawing board to double-check it. After scrutinizing it thoroughly, even (subject.he/she) sees glaring flaws in its execution, and writes a report detailing all (subject.his/her) mistakes. The next day (subject.he/she) consults (subject.his/her) senior colleagues to help (subject.him/her) work out the kinks in (subject.his/her) plan, and over time (subject) learns many things from their strict guidance. It turns out (subject.he/she) had much to learn, but was too blinded by ambition to notice their shortcomings. (Subject) promises to be more humble and learn from (subject.his/her) elders before stubbornly taking matters into (subject.his/her) own hands.
